content_type.description: Content-Type header sent with the request body.

auth_header.description: Optional Authorization header value (e.g. 'Bearer xyz'). Supports ${env:VAR} / ${file:/path}.

events.description: Optional whitelist of alert kinds. If omitted, all kinds are delivered.

template.description: Optional payload template with {{var}} placeholders. If omitted, the event is serialised as JSON. Variables: type, ip, subnet, ip_count, severity, reason, country, asn, node_id, address, score, top_detectors, path, bans_per_minute, threshold.
